arStrings.szText: {c_important}Blood Surge's{/c} nova echoes again after a short delay, dealing {c_number}{payload:ECHO_DAMAGE}{/c} damage.

{c_important}Blood Surge{/c} expels smaller blood novas on your {c_important}Minions{/c}, dealing {c_number}{payload:LEGENDARY_MINION_NOVA}{/c} damage.

{c_important}Blood Surge's{/c} minion nova damage is increased by {c_number}[{SF_1} * 100|%x|]{/c} for each enemy drawn from, up to {c_number}[SF_6 * 100|%x|]{/c}.

{c_important}Blood Surge{/c} becomes a {c_important}Bone{/c} Skill and, instead of expelling a blood nova, expels {c_number}{SF_35}{/c} piercing bone shards dealing {c_number}{payload:SHARD_DAMAGE}{/c} damage each.

Instead of dealing increased damage, {c_important}Blood Surge{/c} expels {c_number}1{/c} additional shard for each enemy drawn from, up to {c_number}[{SF_36} - {SF_35}]{/c} additional shards.
{c_important}Blood Surge{/c} deals {c_number}[SF_7*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage while you are {c_important}{u}Healthy{/c}{/u}.

{c_important}Blood Surge{/c} {c_important}{u}Fortifies{/c}{/u} you for {c_number}[{SF_12}*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}([PlayerHealthMax() * SF_12]){/c} for each enemy drawn from, up to {c_number}[{SF_11}*100|%|]{/c}.

{c_important}Blood Surge{/c} consumes {c_number}{SF_42}{/c} stacks of {c_important}{u}Overpower{/c}{/u} to gain {c_number}[{SF_41}*100|%|]{/c} {if:Mod.VariantC}more projectiles{else}increased Size{/if} and {c_number}[{SF_43}*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage.
